fullDescription: WinTalent design system: A clean, high-performance SaaS dashboard for interviewing and recruitment. Features a technical blue and slate palette, Plus Jakarta Sans typography, and a structured three-column layout. Ideal for HR tech, fintech, and professional enterprise tools. Utilizes glassmorphism, subtle shadows, and crisp JetBrains Mono for data-heavy elements. Optimized for focus and workflow efficiency with bento-grid inspired card structures.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated interviewer workbench featuring a three-column layout: a left-hand navigation and candidate queue, a central assessment area with high-detail question cards, and a right-hand sidebar for time tracking and real-time progress. The UI emphasizes clarity through wide spacing, bold typography, and a professional blue/slate color system.

## Estilo Visual
Style Guide: 
- Colors: Background: #F8FAFC (slate-50); Primary: #2563EB (blue-600); Secondary: #64748B (slate-500); Borders: #E2E8F0 (slate-200); Text-heading: #0F172A (slate-900). 
- Typography: Primary font 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Use 30px Bold for main headers, 18px Semi-Bold for sub-headers, and 11px Bold Uppercase with 0.1em tracking for category labels. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for numerical timers. 
- Borders/Shadows: Radius: 24px (cards), 12px (buttons). Shadows: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05). 
- Animations: 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for hover scales (1.02x); slow pulse (3s) for active status indicators.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation Sidebar
Fixed left sidebar (352px). Top section: Logo and category label. Middle: Navigation items with active state (#eff6ff background, #2563eb text). Bottom: 'Today's Queue' containing mini-cards for upcoming tasks, featuring small avatars and timestamp badges.

### Candidate Header
Hero section for the main content area. Padded card (32px) featuring a large (112px) 3D-styled avatar with a white border. Display name in 30px bold text. Include a row of feature tags (React, TypeScript) using #f8fafc backgrounds and #64748b uppercase text.

### Assessment Question Cards
Standard card with 32px padding and 24px radius. Top row: Question text in 18px bold slate-800. Right side: Interactive 5-star rating system using #fbbf24 for active states. Bottom section: A dedicated 'Reference Guide' box in #f8fafc with a 2-column grid explaining evaluation criteria and scoring standards.

### Right Session Sidebar
Right sidebar (320px). Top: High-contrast blue card (#2563eb) containing a large mono-spaced timer. Middle: Vertical progress timeline using custom nodes (Green for complete, Blue-pulse for active, Faded for upcoming). Bottom: A feedback 'nugget' box in #fffbeb with an info icon.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Progress Timeline — A vertical stepper indicating workflow status.
Implement a vertical timeline with a 1px slate-100 central line. Completed steps use a 28px green circle with a check icon. Active steps use a 28px blue-600 circle with an inner white play icon and a surrounding 'ping' animation. Pending steps are 30% opacity.

### Reference Guidance Box — Contextual help inside assessment cards.
Inner card within questions using background #f8fafc/80 and a thin #f1f5f9 border. Includes an iconified header 'Evaluation Guide'. Content is split into two columns: 'Core Points' and 'Scoring Benchmarks', using 1.5px bullet points for readability.

### SaaS Utility Header — Top-bar for global actions.
Sticky 64px height header. White background with #e2e8f0 bottom border. Left: Dynamic breadcrumb/status text. Right: Action group featuring a secondary 'Pause' button and a primary 'Submit' button with a heavy blue shadow (shadow-blue-200).

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain strict 40px vertical spacing between main sections. MUST use uppercase for all metadata labels (e.g., 'INTERVIEW TIMER'). MUST NOT use sharp corners (minimum 12px radius on all interactive elements). Ensure the background of the main content area is #f8fafc to make white cards pop.

style.description: The style is modern-corporate with a focus on 'Technical Elegance'. It uses a primary tech-blue (#2563eb) against a soft slate background (#f8fafc). Typography pairs 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for interfaces and 'JetBrains Mono' for time-sensitive data. Components use large border-radii (up to 24px) and subtle 'report-card' shadows to create depth without visual noise.
